7 of Clubs

Seven of Clubs - curiosity and weirdness generously spread over four interdisciplinary talks, in Central London!

​Since its inception in 2015 Seven of clubs has been hosting 100s of artists, scientists, entrepreneurs, designers, librarians, poets, tea masters, and social advocates.
